state.rule: Person invariant: one recorded workforce person has immutable creation identity, revisioned contact content and at most one current platform membership correlation. Revisions and correlation use an expected revision; an exact successful revision retry becomes stale by design.
state.revise_behavior: Revise with expected revision equal to current and valid values identical to current values appends a PersonRevised fact and increments the revision. The catalog states no no-op rule for revise.
state.correlate_behavior: Correlate to the user already correlated, at the current revision, appends nothing and succeeds. Correlate with a different user at the current revision replaces the link with revision plus one. Clearing a never-correlated person appends nothing.
state.record_retry: Record after later revise and correlate facts, with the original normalized values, returns the original registration with no new fact. Record with different values returns a conflict with no new fact.
state.tests: Replay of the three facts into a fresh rules object restores revision 3 and the correlated user; a stale revise at revision 2 is refused and a revise at revision 3 succeeds.

replace_correlation_consistent.instructions: Is replacing the current correlation with a different user at the current revision (one new revision, one fact) consistent with 'at most one current platform membership correlation'?

criteria.true: A single current link is kept; replacement is one atomic revision.
criteria.false: Replacement must first be cleared by a separate fact.

record_retry_consistent.instructions: Is acknowledging a creation retry with the original normalized values after later facts, without a new fact, and refusing changed values, consistent with 'immutable creation identity'?

criteria.true: Creation identity and original intent are immutable; an exact retry is acknowledged without a new fact.
criteria.false: A retry after later facts must be refused or must append a fact.

revise_unchanged.instructions: A revise at the current revision carries values identical to the current values. Which disposition fits the stated rule and the stated absence of a no-op rule?

options.append_revision: Keep appending a revision fact because the catalog states no no-op rule.
options.noop_success: Acknowledge with no fact because nothing changed.
options.needs_source_resolution: The catalog is silent; a source decision is needed before changing behavior.

criteria.append_revision: The expected revision is consumed as a recorded decision by the caller.
criteria.noop_success: A fact with no business change records nothing and bumps the revision needlessly.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: Behavior change should wait for an owner decision.

revise_unchanged_premise.instructions: Is it true that the approved model text gives no rule on revise-with-unchanged-values, so the code behavior (append a revision fact) is not contradicted by the model?

criteria.true: The model is silent on this case.
criteria.false: The model explicitly requires a no-op.
